subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): preserve current-room aliases across plugin upgrades

question: Should OpenClaw core guarantee that external channel plugins receive the host-authorized canonical active-conversation target when a delegated action supplies an equivalent current-room alias?
rationale: The implementation is a bounded compatibility repair, but the chosen location makes canonical target handoff a durable cross-plugin contract with authorization and upgrade implications.

options.title: Accept the shared target contract
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, accept canonical active-target handoff as a core-to-external-plugin contract, and merge with the existing focused and live proof.

options.title: Constrain normalization to Nextcloud Talk
options.body: Keep shared dispatch unchanged and implement equivalent current-room alias handling in the owner plugin if maintainers do not want this behavior generalized.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared target contract
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, accept canonical active-target handoff as a core-to-external-plugin contract, and merge with the existing focused and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies the author as the best current technical contact for clarifying the proposed compatibility path; the acceptance decision itself remains for repository maintainers.
